messages.subject: Will Renjin with Scala
messages.body_plain:
Hi
This project is very interesting to me, and I would like to know if Renjin can integrate with Scala or vice-versa

thanks

messages.subject: Re: Will Renjin with Scala
messages.body_plain:
Sure, Renjin is a JVM library and so can be used with Scala like any other JVM library. See instructions for setting up a Scala project with SBT and Renjin:
http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/library/project-setup.html#scala-build-tool-sbt

Best,
Alex
